english.title: Fail to produce a motorcycle training course certificate of competence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person driving a motor bicycle, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTORCYCLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), who had produced a provisional licence to a constable, and whom the said constable had reasonable cause to believe was not driving such motor bicycle as part of the training being provided on a training course for motor cyclists, failed, on being so required, to produce your certificate of completion of a training course for motor cyclists
english.legislation: Contrary to section 164(6) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
